question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Baseline: Q3 FY27 guide $108B rev, 74% GM, $9.2B GAAP opex; GAAP ex-gains ≈ non-GAAP (opex diff only $0.2B), consensus ~$2.47-2.53 at midpoint, typical beat lifts operating GAAP EPS to ~$2.50-2.62. Equity marks are the swing: SpaceX ~$105-115 late July → $146 Oct 16 (+~$4B on 122.8M sh), Intel $92.32 (Jul 24) → $89.85 (−$0.5B), CoreWeave modestly lower; net ~+$3B pre-tax ≈ +$0.10/sh. Right tail: OpenAI $30B round at $1.4T (Nvidia holds $30B at $852B mark) could add ~$0.6/sh if it closes before ~Oct 25 — not closed as of Oct 6; Anthropic IPO talk. Left tail: last-week chip selloff. No human market on GAAP EPS found (only a Manifold revenue market; Kalshi/bookmakers none found).

- Searched, not found: exact SPCX close on Jul 24; Coherent/Nokia/Synopsys price moves; any closed private round for Nvidia's private holdings in Aug-Oct; Kalshi/Polymarket EPS market (none found).

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the guidance inputs and the ~$2.43-2.45 core at the midpoint. The judgment dispute is the size of the beat (2-4% vs 4-6%); I took ~4%, matching Q2's beat of its guide. On the factual side, the SpaceX stake size differs between runs (122.8M shares vs ~$21B); I used the 13F share count, which implies +$4.4B on Oct 16 prices. CoreWeave's late-July price can't be confirmed from the dossiers, so I estimated a -$1-1.5B drag. The report-date conflict (Nov 17 vs Nov 25) doesn't affect the value. Whether the OpenAI round closes before quarter end can't be settled without web access; I left it as right-tail mass. Net marks come to about +$0.08, giving a median ~$2.64 with a right skew.
